rules.title: Boston home rule petition for rent stabilization (H.3744)
rules.requirement: This bill would have authorized Boston to adopt rent stabilization, but it was sent to a study order in September 2024 and the 2023-2024 session ended. It is not law, and Boston has no rent cap from this bill.

coverage.summary: Would have authorized rent stabilization in the City of Boston. The page does not give coverage details.

rules.quoted_span: An Act petition for a special law authorizing the city of Boston to implement rent stabilization and tenant eviction protections
rules.interaction: Home rule petition needing state legislative approval. Massachusetts law otherwise bars local rent control.
rules.conflict_note: Bill history ends with 'Accompanied a study order, see H5035' (9/9/2024). Treated as failed because the 193rd session ended, but the page does not expressly say the bill died.

rules.title: Boston home rule petition for tenant eviction protections (H.3744)
rules.requirement: This bill would have authorized Boston to adopt tenant eviction protections, but it was sent to a study order in September 2024 and was not enacted. It is not law.

coverage.summary: Would have authorized tenant eviction protections in the City of Boston. The page does not give coverage details.

rules.quoted_span: An Act petition for a special law authorizing the city of Boston to implement rent stabilization and tenant eviction protections
rules.conflict_note: Bill history ends with 'Accompanied a study order, see H5035' (9/9/2024). Treated as failed because the 193rd session ended. The page gives no details on what the eviction protections would have been.

notes: The document is a bill-status page only and does not include the bill text, so it gives no cap formula, coverage, or eviction causes. Status is inferred as failed: the bill was sent to a study order (H5035) and the 2023-2024 session has ended.
